scope.summary: SHELL-004 shell frontend audit evidence timeline renders one Cloud IAM policy operation class from the durable Cloud Observability audit read source, with explicit G007/AUTHZ-006 authority anchors and a non-mutating boundary marker.
explicit_non_claims: No provider mutation, cloud control-plane write, live tenant data import, credential exposure, or production persistence is introduced.
The audit timeline is a read-only UI/static rendering slice over the durable Cloud Observability audit read API fixture and does not claim a full provider-backed audit console.
Pre-existing dirty workspace changes outside the SHELL-004 app.rs and this evidence packet were not reviewed or modified for this card.

facets.F2_correctness: The shell frontend parses the Cloud Observability audit read response shape with deny_unknown_fields, filters the timeline to cloud_iam_policy, carries signed digest-chain fields into design-system rows, and asserts static SSR markers for endpoint, authz surface, operation class, authority refs, complete chain state, high watermark, signed export, and idempotency key.
facets.F3_security: The panel is explicitly read-only and analysis-only/non-mutating; it exposes no credentials and does not introduce provider write paths or live secret handling.
facets.F4_data_boundary: Rendered values are scoped to the durable audit response fixture and preserve INTERNAL_ONLY/AUDIT labels as evidence text; no external tenant data source or cross-tenant query is wired.
facets.F5_testing: cargo fmt --check -p oya-application-shell-frontend; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/oyatie-t_5f5d9a01-target cargo test -p oya-application-shell-frontend audit_evidence_timeline_uses_durable_cloud_observability_source --lib --features ssr -- --nocapture; git diff --check -- oya/application/crates/oya-application-shell-frontend/src/app.rs.
facets.F6_rollback: Revert the SHELL-004 app.rs hunks and remove this evidence packet if the cloud audit UI source authority changes or the shell timeline is superseded.
facets.F7_operability: Operators can identify durable source endpoint, authz surface, G007/AUTHZ-006 authority anchors, chain completeness, high-watermark sequence, request, tenant, region, and cursor in the static shell timeline section.
facets.F8_performance: The slice renders a bounded fixture-backed timeline row list with no network call or provider mutation on the shell render path.
facets.F9_compliance: The UI preserves audit-chain, data-class, signed-export, and non-mutating boundary language instead of downgrading evidence to local fixture-only or mock claims.
facets.F10_reversibility: Changes are additive to the shell frontend timeline and evidence metadata, with no generated JSON, schema migration, or persistent cloud state mutation.
facets.F11_observability: Kanban heartbeats, focused test output, and this multispectrum packet record the validation path and source-authority markers.
facets.F13_migration: The implementation keeps the current docs/AGENTS/root-hub operating-contract compatibility path and avoids relying on retired CLI merge authority.
